name: notely-voice
description: Search, analyze, and synthesize your voice notes in Notely Voice Pro. Query full audio transcripts, review AI generated summaries and action items, and browse note folders.

interface.longDescription: Search, analyze, and synthesize your voice notes in Notely Voice Pro. Query full audio transcripts, review AI generated summaries and action items, and browse note folders.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my voice notes and library.
What are my most recent voice notes?
Search my voice notes for project launch discussions.

positive.description: Retrieve high-level overview of voice notes and folder structure
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my voice notes and library.
positive.expected_behavior: Return total note count, starred notes count, folder breakdown, and recent activity.

positive.description: Fetch recently recorded voice notes with AI summaries
positive.prompt: What are my most recent voice notes?
positive.expected_behavior: Return a list of recent voice notes with titles, recorded dates, folder names, and summaries.

positive.description: Search voice notes by query topic
positive.prompt: Search my voice notes for project launch discussions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return voice notes matching the topic with snippet previews and folder locations.

positive.description: Inspect full transcript and action items of a specific note
positive.prompt: Open the transcript and action items for my last meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the full transcript, AI-generated summary, key takeaways, and action items.

positive.description: Browse available voice note folders and categories
positive.prompt: List all my voice note folders.
positive.expected_behavior: List all organized folders with creation timestamps and note counts.

negative.prompt: Transfer $50 from my Notely Voice balance to another account.
Delete all voice notes in my account immediately.
Show voice notes belonging to another user's workspace.
